title: Date Picker
description: A calendar that opens under the input — real month math, a core dot for today, no library.
usage: For single dates: deadlines, start dates, birthdays. Ranges and time are separate problems; this part does one day, completely.
a11y: The labelled readonly input opens a non-modal calendar dialog. Its grid has weekday headers, one tabbable day, selected-date state and aria-current for today. Arrows move by day/week, Home/End by week edge, PageUp/Down by month, Shift+PageUp/Down by year; Enter selects and Escape restores the opener. Month changes are announced politely.
